description: This file defines classes and functions related to file system operations, including file handling, directory management, and partition information within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, and provides abstractions for file attributes, file operations, directory traversal, and partition details.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for creation, opening, reading, writing, moving, and attribute management, supporting both Windows and POSIX platforms.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Provides directory traversal and management functionalities, including creation, deletion, and safe path handling, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Encapsulates information about disk partitions, including size, free space, and mount points, with platform-specific methods for loading partition info.

methods.name: FileName
methods.description: Extracts the filename from a full path.

methods.name: FileNameExtended
methods.description: Returns the filename with extension from a full path.

methods.name: PathName
methods.description: Returns the directory path from a full filename.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: ErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the last error code from the platform-specific API.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the file handle is valid and open.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if the file attributes indicate existence.

methods.name: IsReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the file is marked as read-only.

methods.name: IsHidden
methods.description: Checks if the file is hidden.

methods.name: IsSystem
methods.description: Checks if the file is a system file.

methods.name: IsArchive
methods.description: Checks if the file is marked as an archive.

methods.name: IsDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the file is a directory.

methods.name: IsLink
methods.description: Checks if the file is a symbolic link.

methods.name: IsCompressed
methods.description: Checks if the file is compressed (Windows only).

methods.name: IsEncrypted
methods.description: Checks if the file is encrypted (Windows only).

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: SetSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link to the file.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new file with default or specified mode.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the file for reading.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the file with specified read-only mode.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Opens the file for appending.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Deletes the file.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Moves the file to a new location.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the file handle.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the file.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the file.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Sets the file pointer position.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Gets the current file pointer position.

methods.name: DuplicateHandle
methods.description: Duplicates the file handle.

methods.name: LoadFileInfo
methods.description: Loads file metadata such as size and timestamps.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a directory path.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates the directory.

methods.name: CreatePath
methods.description: Creates the directory path.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next directory entry.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Recursively deletes directory contents.

methods.name: LoadPartitionInfo
methods.description: Loads partition size and free space information.
